name: Advanced Power System Protection and Switchgear

units.title: Introduction to Digital Relays
topics: Comparison of digital relays with previous generation relays
Basic Components of Digital Relays with block diagram
Concept of analog to digital and digital to analog conversion
Different relay algorithms such as algorithms for pure sinusoidal relaying signal
algorithm based on solution of system differential equations
Fourier analysis based half cycle and full cycle algorithm

units.title: Coordination of Inverse Definite Minimum Time
topics: (IDMT)/Directional Over Current (DOC) Relays in an Interconnected Power System Network Protection of an interconnected system
Examples based on existing power system network

units.title: Wide Area Protection and Measurement
topics: advantageous of adaptive relaying and its application

units.title: Auto-reclosing and Synchronizing
topics: auto-reclosing based on number of phases
auto-reclosing based on number of attempts
Sequence of events in single-shot auto-reclosing scheme
factors to be considered during reclosing such as choice of zone in case of distance relay

units.title: System Response during Severe Upsets
topics: Nature of system response to severe upsets such as system response to Islanding conditions
Factors to be considered for load shedding scheme such as maximum anticipated overload
size of load shed at each step
Issues with islanding and methods of islanding

units.title: Protection of Series Compensated Transmission Line
topics: basic components of series compensated transmission lines
Voltage Profile of Series Compensated Line
Protection problems such as Voltage Inversion
